mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS id, c.page_id AS pageId, p.parent_id AS parentId, c.version AS version, c.describe AS describe, c.content AS content, p.title AS title, c.updated_on AS updatedOn, c.mem_id AS memId FROM wiki_page p JOIN wiki_content c ON p.last_ver = c.version AND p.id = c.page_id WHERE p.id = #{id}

SELECT p.id AS id, c.page_id AS pageId, p.parent_id AS parentId, c.version AS version, c.describe AS describe, c.content AS content, p.title AS title, c.updated_on AS updatedOn, c.mem_id AS memId, GET_USERID_TO_NAME(c.mem_id) AS modifierName FROM wiki_page p JOIN wiki_content c ON p.id = c.page_id WHERE p.id = #{pageId} AND c.version = #{version}

SELECT p.id AS id, c.page_id AS pageId, p.parent_id AS parentId, c.version AS version, c.describe AS describe, c.content AS content, p.title AS title, c.updated_on AS updatedOn, c.mem_id AS memId, GET_USERID_TO_NAME(c.mem_id) AS modifierName FROM wiki_page p JOIN wiki_content c ON p.id = c.page_id WHERE p.id = #{pageId} ORDER BY c.version DESC

SELECT p.id AS id, p.wiki_id AS wikiId, p.title AS title, p.last_ver AS lastVer, w.prj_id AS prjId, p.parent_id AS parentId, c.describe AS describe, c.updated_on AS updatedOn FROM wiki_page p JOIN wiki w ON w.id = p.wiki_id LEFT JOIN wiki_content c ON c.page_id = p.id AND c.version = p.last_ver WHERE w.prj_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY p.title
SELECT p.id AS id, p.title AS title, p.parent_id AS parentId FROM wiki_page p START WITH p.id = #{pageId} CONNECT BY PRIOR p.parent_id = id ORDER BY LEVEL DESC
mapper.insert:
select w_page_seq.nextval from dual
insert into wiki_page (id, title, wiki_id, parent_id) values (#{id}, #{title}, (select id from wiki where prj_id = #{prjId}), #{parentId})

select w_content_seq.nextval from dual
insert into wiki_content (id,version, page_id, content,describe,mem_Id) values (#{id}, 1,#{pageId}, #{content}, #{describe}, #{memId})

select w_content_seq.nextval from dual
insert into wiki_content (id,version, page_id, content,describe,mem_Id) values (#{id}, (select max(version)+1 from wiki_content where page_id =#{pageId}),#{pageId}, #{content}, #{describe}, #{memId})
